night_actions: Nhan (Seer) investigated Cong. Cong is NOT a wolf.
Nam (Witch) used SAVE potion on Nhan

day_debate.speaker: Nam
day_debate.statement: Nhan was targeted last night. I saved him. His behavior today will reveal much about the wolves' strategy and his own alignment. Let's observe him carefully.

day_debate.speaker: Jin
day_debate.statement: Nam claims to have saved Nhan. Why declare it so openly? A genuine Witch would likely be more discreet. Nhan, your reactions to this claim will be telling. Explain your actions last night.

day_debate.speaker: Nhan
day_debate.statement: Nam's open declaration of saving me is unusual. A true Witch would act with discretion. I request Nam provide verifiable details about his actions last night – what potion did he use, and why reveal it so openly?

day_debate.speaker: Nam
day_debate.statement: Jin's immediate questioning of my actions is a blatant attempt to deflect attention. Nhan's demand for verification is equally suspicious; a genuine Villager would trust the Witch's word. Let's focus on their behavior, not mine.

day_debate.speaker: Jin
day_debate.statement: Nam's declaration is performative and reeks of deception. A Witch protects their identity. Why announce the save? Nhan's questioning is reasonable; Nam's defensiveness confirms my suspicion.

day_debate.speaker: Nhan
day_debate.statement: Nam's insistence on focusing attention on my behavior, coupled with his open declaration of a save, feels manufactured. Jin's scrutiny is warranted; I request further clarification on the specifics of the save.

This kind of performative neutrality is textbook wolf behavior used to deflect scrutiny. I'm inclined to agree that Nam's claim is a risky gambit.
